data_sources.text: All public posts in the local-politics boards of the forum platform, collected through its export interface, January 2019 to December 2023.

subsets.text: Prominent accounts selected by the authors as known to be active in council debates.

measures.text: Concentration: share of posts written by the most active 1% of accounts.
Reference to a council decision: post contains the name of an agenda item from the council minutes.
Incivility coded with a fine-tuned BERT classifier, compared with two coders on 500 posts.

design.text: Shares and distributions over the full collection; a before/after comparison of the uncivil share around March 2021 without a control design.
